title: 美银CEO莫伊尼汉：项目储备很满，交易为何推到明年初
speaker: Brian Moynihan

segments.en: Speaking to Bloomberg, Moynihan also told us more about how the bank is preparing for those major IPOs. There's a lot of work. We can't talk about current IPOs, obviously, but thinking back to the ones on the screen there,
segments.zh: 莫伊尼汉对彭博社表示，银行正在为这些大型IPO做准备。工作量很大。显然不能谈论当前的IPO，但回想屏幕上那些，

segments.en: it's a lot of work, a lot of enthusiasm, getting it all organized, the road trips and everything.
segments.zh: 工作量很大，热情很高，要组织路演等一切事宜。

segments.en: There's a lot of calls out to all the advisors and stuff.
segments.zh: 要打很多电话给所有顾问等等。

segments.en: The team does a great job and we look forward to that happening.
segments.zh: 团队做得很好，我们期待那发生。

segments.en: How unprecedented, which is the word that gets thrown around a lot, but how unprecedented has Capra Marcus activity been in the last 12-18 months?
segments.zh: 过去12-18个月，Capra Marcus的活动有多前所未有？这个词常被提及。

segments.en: Well, it was up. The Capra Marcus activity, when you all get down with the year, will be a chunk, but it's been very bumpy.
segments.zh: 嗯，它上升了。到年底，Capra Marcus的活动将是一大块，但一直很颠簸。

segments.en: What's happening today is right now, as deals are getting pushed into the early next year, largely because of the uncertainty that underlies.
segments.zh: 今天的情况是，交易正被推到明年初，主要是因为潜在的不确定性。

segments.en: This is a different kind of company, but run the mill companies, general companies, buy tech companies, some of the stuff sliding in the next year, the team tells me over the weekend.
segments.zh: 这是一家不同类型的公司，但普通公司、一般公司、收购科技公司，一些东西滑到明年，团队周末告诉我。

segments.en: It's not because they won't get down. It's just trying to let the markets settle in after this major transaction.
segments.zh: 不是因为他们不会完成，而是想让市场在这笔重大交易后稳定下来。

segments.en: And we'll see what happens next. So the pipeline's full.
segments.zh: 我们看看接下来会发生什么。所以管道是满的。

segments.en: The stuff's moving around a little bit. We feel good about it.
segments.zh: 情况有些波动，但我们感觉良好。

segments.en: And the team's done a good job of captioning their pieces.
segments.zh: 团队在内容标注方面做得不错。
